# Tate Programs

Tate Programs runs B2B agent-commerce readiness sprints, fixed-scope launch reviews, and small implementation sprints for paid agent APIs, x402, Pay.sh, MPP, AgentCore, MCP, JavaScript, TypeScript, and GitHub Action launches.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://tateprograms.com/) - Focused B2B paid-offer page for agent-commerce readiness maps, launch sprints, recurring monitors, private x402 launch reviews, proof signals, and current May 2026 agent-payment market positioning.
- [Agent Commerce Readiness Sprint](https://tateprograms.com/agent-commerce-readiness-sprint.html) - B2B readiness sprint for companies launching agent-discoverable catalogs, paid APIs, UCP, ACP, AP2, TAP, x402 routes, MPP flows, AgentCore integrations, receipts, spend controls, failure recovery, and partner-ready launch proof. Tiers: $750 readiness map, $2,500 launch sprint, and $4,500/month readiness monitor.
- [Agent Readiness Monitor](https://tateprograms.com/agent-readiness-monitor.html) - $4,500/month external readiness monitor for fast-moving agent-commerce, x402, MCP, UCP, paid API, marketplace, and governed agent launches. Weekly drift checks cover discovery files, payment challenges, docs and route mismatch, browser-header regressions, receipt and retry wording, marketplace claims, buyer-risk queue, proof commands, and monthly private summary.
- [Outside Proof Packet](https://tateprograms.com/outside-proof-packet.html) - Fixed $750 public-surface evidence packet for agent-commerce, x402, MCP, UCP, marketplace, and security-tool launches. Covers discovery files, payment or tool boundaries, browser/readback behavior, cache and CORS posture, replay commands, and ranked patch order.
- [Agentic Commerce Product Data Audit](https://tateprograms.com/agentic-commerce-product-data-audit.html) - Fixed $750 outside proof packet for retailers, marketplaces, product-data platforms, commerce agents, and ecommerce agencies preparing catalog data for AI-referred shoppers, Google AI Mode, Universal Cart, UCP, ACP, MCP, policy evidence, checkout handoffs, and agent-readable product discovery.
- [AI Mode + UCP Agency Partner](https://tateprograms.com/ai-mode-ucp-agency.html) - White-label readiness maps for ecommerce, paid media, CRO, SEO, Shopify, WooCommerce, and product-data agencies preparing clients for Google AI Mode, Universal Cart, UCP, Lighthouse Agentic Browsing, WebMCP, structured product data, public checkout discovery, and agentic commerce. Entry tier: $750 per client; implementation support starts at $2,500+.
- [Agent Readiness Proof Packet](https://tateprograms.com/agent-readiness-proof.html) - Outside proof packets for agent-readiness products, agencies, and ecommerce teams covering `llms.txt`, `agents.json`, MCP server cards, agent skills, WebMCP, Lighthouse Agentic Browsing, Cloudflare-style discovery, schema, sitemap, public action surfaces, and client-safe patch order. Entry tier: $750 per approved surface; partner support starts at $2,500+.
- [MCP Agent Security Proof Packet](https://tateprograms.com/agent-security-evidence-2026.html) - Outside proof packets for MCP, agent-tool, runtime-security, marketplace-skill, enterprise-copilot, and agent-demo launches covering public discovery, tool boundaries, prompt-injection and exfiltration exposure, policy actions, audit evidence, A2A identity, human review gates, ranked patch order, and re-check. Entry tier: $750 per approved surface; partner support starts at $2,500+.
- [Agent Booking Readiness Proof Packet](https://tateprograms.com/agent-booking-readiness.html) - Outside proof packets for hotel, restaurant, food delivery, hospitality agency, booking-engine, and direct-booking teams preparing for Google AI Mode, UCP, MCP, agentic booking, menus, rates, availability, policies, booking/order handoff, and guest-data/payment boundaries. Entry tier: $750 per approved public surface; partner support starts at $2,500+.
- [Agent Readiness Sample Report](https://tateprograms.com/agent-readiness-sample-report.html) - Fictional public-surface report showing the output shape for a $750 outside proof packet: discovery files, agent-readable actions, schema and sitemap evidence, public/private boundary, and priority patch order.
- [Google Universal Cart and UCP Readiness](https://tateprograms.com/universal-cart-readiness.html) - Private readiness map for retailers, Shopify teams, agencies, checkout platforms, and UCP/AP2 partner pilots preparing product catalogs, carts, checkout handoff, payment boundaries, receipts, refunds, and partner proof after Google I/O 2026. Entry tier: $750 readiness map for one commerce surface.
- [Universal Cart / UCP Readiness Check](https://tateprograms.com/ucp-readiness-check.html) - Free server-backed public checker for Universal Cart and UCP merchant readiness. Fetches only public surfaces such as homepage, `/.well-known/ucp`, profile-advertised service endpoints, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `agents.md`, default and declared UCP MCP endpoints, robots, sitemap, and `sitemap_agentic_discovery.xml`; scores discovery, UCP MCP reachability, product schema, shipping, returns, Shopify signals, and checkout context without login, cart mutation, payment, or order lookup. API: https://the402.tateprograms.com/api/ucp/readiness.
- [Universal Cart Readiness Sample: Allbirds](https://tateprograms.com/universal-cart-readiness-sample-allbirds.html) - Public-only sample report showing the output shape for a merchant readiness snapshot: UCP profile, agent docs, MCP endpoint behavior, agentic sitemap, product schema gaps, policy schema gaps, and the boundary between public discovery and private checkout proof.
- [BNB Chain x402 and B402 Readiness](https://tateprograms.com/bnb-chain-x402-readiness.html) - Private readiness map for BNB Chain x402, B402-style HTTP payment, ERC-8004 identity, paid API, and agent-commerce launch surfaces. Entry tier: $750 readiness map for one public surface.

## Repositories And Packages

- [Shipcheck CLI npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shipcheck-cli) - Public npm package, runnable with `npx --yes shipcheck-cli .`.
- [Shipcheck MCP npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shipcheck-mcp) - Public MCP server package for running Shipcheck from MCP clients.
- [Shipcheck Action](https://github.com/TateLyman/shipcheck-action) - GitHub Action wrapper for Shipcheck.
- [Shipcheck MCP](https://github.com/TateLyman/shipcheck-mcp) - MCP server source repository.
- [Tate Programs site](https://github.com/TateLyman/tate-web-services) - Static site source.
- [x402 Cache-Safe Worker](https://github.com/TateLyman/x402-cache-safe-worker) - Cloudflare Worker starter for cache-safe x402-style payment gates with CORS, no-store/private cache policy, resource echo, and smoke tests.
- [x402 Surface Check Action](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/x402-surface-check) - GitHub Marketplace Action for running no-payment x402, MPP, Pay.sh, AgentCore-style, and HTTP 402 launch-surface checks in CI.
- [x402 Triage MCP Repo](https://github.com/TateLyman/x402-triage-mcp) - npm package source and official MCP Registry-listed server for public x402 launch triage and 402 Index watch workflows.
- [Agent Skill Trust Check Repo](https://github.com/TateLyman/agent-skill-trust-check) - Static pre-install scanner for SKILL.md, OpenClaw, Hermes, MCP, and paid agent-skill marketplace listings.
